text:
```yaml
name: Code Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    types: [ opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review ]

jobs:
  review:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --no-restore

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

      - name: Code Review
        uses: github/codeql-action@v2
        with:
          language: csharp
          category: "csharp"
          query: |
            // Review for module-scoped isolation issues
            // Focus on:
            // 1. Proper module scoping of context objects
            // 2. Isolation of loggers, state, and dependencies
            // 3. Immutable environment context properties
            // 4. Explicit AsyncLocal cleanup
            // 5. Logger initialization patterns
            // 6. Module context awareness in services
            // 7. Consistent singleton/scoped registrations
```
